644: 
645: * All input is assumed to be ASCII compatible (which means every byte that
646:   corresponds to an ASCII codepoint actually is an ASCII codepoint). This

648: * ripgrep works best with UTF-8. For example, ripgrep's regular expression

650:   match all word characters by Unicode's definition and `.` will match any
651:   Unicode codepoint instead of any byte. These constructions assume UTF-8,
